typography.hierarchy_rules: Large scale, tracking-tight for headers. Uppercase with tracking-widest for overlines. Never center text by default, use left alignment for strong editorial structure.
typography.fonts_installation: Import from Fontshare or Google Fonts. e.g., @import url('https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,500,700,400,900&f[]=satoshi@900,700,500,400&display=swap');

colors.rules: No purple, no teal. Pure grayscale with deep blue accents for CTAs and highlights. High contrast is mandatory.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento grids for pricing/services, wide asymmetry for portfolio. Generous spacing (gap-12 to gap-24).
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very minimal (rounded-sm) to keep it brutalist/sleek.

sections.name: Header
sections.style: Glassmorphism dark (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl), border-b border-white/10. Sticky top z-50. Minimalist logo, 3-5 links, primary CTA in dark blue.

sections.name: Hero
sections.style: Full height min-h-screen, custom generated background with overlay (bg-black/50 to bg-black/80 gradient). Huge typography quote ('Designed in silence. Built to be remembered.' or similar catchy quote) left-aligned with extreme negative space.

sections.name: Portfolio
sections.style: Numbered sections (01 / Selected Work, 02 / Selected Work) imitating the reference site. Large mockup images with hover effects. 3 placeholder website cards (links empty).

sections.name: Services / Website Packs
sections.style: 3-column bento grid. Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Packages: Standard ($299), Premium ($799), Monthly Subscription ($75). Use subtle dark blue accent on the Monthly Subscription card (e.g., border-blue-900 or dark blue glow).

sections.name: Conversion Rate Calculator
sections.style: Interactive tool. Inputs: monthly visitors (500), conversion rate (5%), average job price ($10,000 editable). Outputs: projected revenue/ROI. Styled like a sleek terminal or dark minimalist card with a glowing blue trace border.

sections.name: About / Why Akron
sections.style: Text-heavy, large typography. High contrast Swiss style. Explaining web design for service-based businesses.

sections.name: Contact Form
sections.style: Minimalist form. Fields: Name, Email, Phone, Message. Shadcn inputs with border-white/10 and sharp edges. Dark blue submit button.

sections.name: Footer
sections.style: Massive typography for 'Akron Digital'. Contact info clearly displayed: 647-745-5082, Goncalo@akrondigital.com, GTA Ontario.

sections.name: AI Assistant Chatbot Widget
sections.style: Floating bottom right. Circular or pill-shaped blue accent button. Persistent across the page.

image_urls.description: Dark geometric architectural background for hero section.
Minimalist dark office for About section

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dark, minimalist, high-contrast marketing site. Use pure blacks and dark grays with deep blue accents. AVOID purple/teal. Use large typography (Cabinet Grotesk) and sharp edges. Structure portfolio items with numbering like '01 / Selected Work' and massive typography. Build a functional conversion rate calculator section. Ensure you implement the specific contact information in the footer. Use the provided image URLs exactly. Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
